sarah: Quick heads-up 30: small reconcile window 02:00-02:05 UTC to re-pin runtime and confirm router mapping. API + runtime + router + console handshake.

mike: What	s the trigger?

sarah: Variant metadata mismatch caused a few orgs to hit runtime v3.9 without the compat shim. Low volume but customer-visible.

lee: Router can steer affected orgs to fallback pool pinned to v3.8 while mike repins.

mike: Will cut v3.9.1-repin with explicit compat flag and push to fallback pool.

deploy-bot: preflight OK. Quiet window set.

sarah: Rollout: 1) router steer -> fallback for affected orgs 2) apply repin 3) verify traces 4) remove steer. Rollback: revert steer + unpin.

lee: Acknowledged. I	ll run steer and watch 503s.

mike: Repin applied. Monitoring.

lee: Steer applied -> affected orgs -> fallback. No 5xx spike.

mike: Metrics good, repin resolved field-drop traces.

sarah: Removing steer and closing window. I	ll drop a short note in #release-notes.

deploy-bot: orchestration finished successfully.
